test_item:
AuthData files, as well as additional files (ValidityCounter, Timestamp,SequenceId) should be stored at "data" partition and labeled by SELinux
(AuthData files are stored in the data partition and labeled by SELinux)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. AuthData has been successfully installed on the DUT
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /data/vendor/dauth on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth
2. Read the SELinux label of the AuthData directory on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -Z /data/vendor/dauth
er:
1. The adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth output lists the installed AuthData files
2. The adb shell ls -Z /data/vendor/dauth output shows the SELinux label on the AuthData files
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
